Somebody tells the story again, the one everybody already knows. For one evening, hunger feels like a rumor. (−1,672 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed.
